text: emma: dropped a compact iteration of org > security & access. Key asks: copy for SSO toggle, where to put Export/Filters for audit logs, and a11y fixes on the role chips. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/XYZ789/org-security-compact. rafael: quick scan 3: role chips label contrast fails on dark-mode only. Using token name --text-subtle on light, but on dark it's too faint. Suggest using --text-muted-contrast or increase to 14px for the metadata. noa: SSO toggle: current label "SSO (SAML)" might confuse non-SAML orgs. Proposing three short variants for A/B: 1) "Require SSO for organization" 2) "Enforce single sign-on" 3) "Turn on SSO (SAML/OIDC)". My pick is #1 for clarity. priya: Agree with #1. Also recommend adding a help link that opens the onboarding modal: "Require SSO for organization" [Learn more]. For keyboard users, the help link needs role="link" and focusable tab order after toggle. design-bot: accessibility check summary: 4 contrast issues (role metadata light-mode, invite-chip small label, divider in header, help link focus ring), 1 missing aria-describedby for audit export confirmation, 3 tabbable elements with no visible focus in dark-mode. Auto-PR created: /a11y/1830450000. emma: good. @eng-lead can you add aria-describedby to the export button so screen readers announce "Export audit log" and the file format? Example: Exports CSV of audit events eng-lead: yes will add that. Also flag: export currently only in overflow menu. Moving it to header seems OK but we should surface Filters alongside Export to keep related actions together. That makes analytics easier to track. analytics: if we move Export into header we should add an event: org.audit.header_export.click and org.audit.menu_export.click to compare. We'll instrument both in parallel during rollout. rafael: small UI nit 3 role grid has the edit icon inline with name which reduces tap target on mobile. Move actions to trailing overflow on narrow widths. noa: keyboard flow bug repro: open org settings, press Tab until you hit first toggle, then Shift+Tab jumps focus into page footer. Suspect a stale focus trap from modal logic. I'll add a unit test simulating Tab/Shift+Tab across the grid. priya: microcopy suggestion for the invite chip tooltip: current text "invited". Try: "Pending invite - expires in 7 days" or "Invite sent (resend)" depending on context. Short, actionable is better. emma: love the invite tooltip variants. Can we standardize on the phrasing pattern: - . e.g., "Pending - expires in 6 days". Keeps strings consistent for translations. design-bot: quick token recommendation: replace --text-subtle (#8f8f8f) with --text-subtle-strong (#3a3a3a) for small inline metadata. Update PR will contain token map. eng-lead: timeline: we'll push the contrast token swap, aria-describedby for export, and SSO label change to "Require SSO for organization" as a small patch. Follow with analytics for header export and A/B test for SSO copy. ETA: this sprint. analytics: will stub events and provide baseline metrics for current overflow export usage. emma: thanks all. If anyone can drop final microcopy options in this thread Ill add to the A/B test config. rafael: final microcopy options for SSO (short list): "Require SSO for organization", "Enforce single sign-on", "Enable SSO for users". noa: adding a11y QA steps to the ticket: color contrast checks, keyboard nav across rows, focus visible in dark-mode, screen reader reads export description. priya: I'll draft the help modal content for SSO onboarding: short bullets for admin steps + links for SAML/OIDC docs. emma: closing loop 3 small patch this week, analytics + A/B next week. Thanks :raised_hands:
